notes: 511 Shires Way, Egg Harbor NJ — fix-and-flip. Net cost basis = capitalized cost on the accrual balance sheet $315,911.92 (Building Property $141,244.31 + Improvements $85,187.76 + CIP $87,871.99 + carrying insurance $98.44 + utilities $1,509.42) PLUS $11,099.24 operating expenses run through the cash-basis P&L (recording $70, insurance $1,876.80, RE tax $8,280.55, postage $19.65, R&M material $482.24, utilities $370) LESS $46,100 U&O income recognized (JE 16846 charge to occupant, booked as rent) = $280,911.16. The $46,100 U&O charge was capitalized into Improvements as a non-cash entry and is exactly offset by the income netting, so net basis equals cash funded plus accrued payables. Reconciliation: basis $280,911.16 = Oak Tree loans $260,000.00 + operating-cash overdraft $19,232.34 + accounts payable $1,630.56 + credit card $48.26 (ties to the penny). AP, overdraft, and credit-card balances are NOT added as basis (funding/timing items per methodology). Interest accrues only on the $260,000 Oak Tree Equities loan draws at 12% simple, actual/365, from each GL draw date. Basis entries do not accrue interest; their dates are the GL transaction/reclass dates (cosmetic only). Selling costs assumed at 6%. Sources: balance sheet (accrual, as of 06/09/2026), income statement (cash, all time), general ledger (cash, all time), all created 06/09/2026.
